## Outcome

What practical support ability will this task demonstrate?

## Target and prerequisites

Machine/VM, milestone, required prior gates, resource/licence checks.

## Work

- [ ] Record current state.
- [ ] Perform the bounded change.
- [ ] Validate expected result and a relevant failure/control case.
- [ ] Restore a clean state or document the new baseline.
- [ ] Add sanitised evidence and update tracking/status.

## Acceptance and rollback

Expected observation, evidence path, and how to reverse the change.

## Related IDs

Requirement IDs, scenario IDs and decision references.
